body: Investigator closed both questions.U+000AU+000ACOUNT. Deterministic, and 814 is the baseline on main. Three sequential runs on clean main at 4458ba76 returned 814 pass 0 fail exit 0 each time; a fourth run inside the fix/close-releases-pointer worktree returned 818, which is 814 plus exactly the four registrations in the new test/spawn/close.test.ts. Registration is static, so the count cannot drift: 784 top-level test calls, the rest from loops over frozen constant arrays, and exactly three unconditional awaited subtests. Fifteen test files call readdirSync but every one enumerates inside a test body rather than registering per file, and no environment probe, platform check or capability gate touches registration.U+000AU+000AThe 818-on-clean-main report is explained by the worktrees being nested at .claude/worktrees/ inside the primary repo: the branch was created from 4458ba76 at 01:32:46 and did not commit until 01:57:59, so for 25 minutes a worktree there answered `git rev-parse HEAD` with 4458ba76 while close.test.ts sat on disk uncommitted. An agent would truthfully report main 4458ba76 and truthfully collect 818. Flagged by the investigator as inference from the exact count match plus the timing window, not from an observed process.U+000AU+000ACriterion check corrected: 01M1TVAVTEHB4DP2TWVQ2524Q0 struck, replaced by 01M1TWKPTR0HE3VTVVV5W7TS5D, whose check names a state and no number, under decision 01M1TWJMEP7MY5SJK7S1ZRAZ7M.U+000AU+000APOINTER FIELDS. The in-repo copy is correct at three fields; the GLOBAL copy is stale. `export type Pointer = { thread_id: Ulid; written_at: Iso8601; session_id: string }` at src/domain/pointer.ts:9. writePointer at :63-72 serialises exactly those three, readPointer at :53-60 projects exactly those three, so an extra stored key is dropped rather than surfaced. The sole writePointer call site is resume_thread.ts:61; update_thread no longer touches the pointer at all. test/unit/pointer.test.ts:164 pins the drop. focus is not a planned feature but a REMOVED one, deleted in commit a1fe9a3d, merged as PR 191, and the global rule still documents the pre-191 shape including the read-back-as-empty-list behaviour that no longer exists. Second global-rule lead dispatched on branch docs/pointer-carries-three-fields.U+000AU+000AFLAKE IS A REAL PRODUCT DEFECT, filed rather than folded in. src/store/write-path.ts:205-207 advances the ledger ref with casUpdateRef and only then runs writeTargetsToDisk, so a concurrent reader opening the store in that window counts more records in the ref tree than on disk and is refused at src/store/records.ts:212-223 with field records, retryable true. The refusal advertises retryable but the test's classifier at test/spawn/decisions.test.ts:879 requires field === 'decision', so the child skips its 20-attempt retry loop and exits 1. Reproduced on an idle machine, so full-suite load is not required. CAS exhaustion against MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5 is ruled out by the refusal text naming materialisation. The fix needs an architect decision first, because write-path.ts:219 documents self-repair while records.ts refuses, and those two disagree.
